correctness.rationale: Borel-Weil and Weyl dimension formula give dim H0(G/B,L_{m rho})=product_{alpha>0}[(m+1)<rho,alpha^vee>/<rho,alpha^vee>]=(m+1)^N. Hence degree N!; Bruhat cells give chi=|W|. Weyl exponents e_i satisfy N=sum e_i and |W|=prod(e_i+1)<=2^N, while N!>2^N for N>=4. Enumerating root systems with N<=3 yields strict below A1,A1^2,A1^3, equality A2. Every step is valid for products and simply connected complex semisimple groups.
